h:
描述

将现有图像转换为另一种样式的 comfyui 工作流程。例如，一张水彩画的照片。

方法论

加载图像。向提示添加样式。玩得开心。

时间

只要使用 SD 1.5 和常规设置在 ComfyUI 中生成图像即可。

要求

这取决于图像的大小。但 8 Gb Vram 应该足够了。

o.en:
Description

A comfyui workflow that converts an existing image to another style. A photo to a watercolor painting for example.

Howto

Load an image. Add a style to the prompt. Have fun.

Time

As long as it takes to generate an image in ComfyUI with SD 1.5 and the usual settings.

Requirements

It depends of the size of the image. But 8 Gb Vram should be enough.
